input.prompt: Generate ONE original 16:9 painted fantasy image. Covenant family: rich hand-painted volumes, worn stone, oxidized metal, pale layered cloth, restrained edge ornament and broad quiet surfaces. No paper or book texture, no all-over grain, no photographs or 3D render. NO words, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, interface or diagrams. No active magic in the guarded camp. Original design only.
